## FluxProof — free source preview and separate setup
Edit grouped public inputs, then run manually. This makes one free request, not a purchase. Read the final typed result; a green execution indicator alone does not prove success. Failed checks never authorize the next step. No credentials, paid engine, automatic retry, schedule or webhook is included.
One preview is not a monitor or change history. A failed fetch is not unchanged.
Attribution is unknown: no supported n8n campaign tag is assumed. Original bounded wrapper: MIT; hosted services, engines and paid access are excluded. Do not enter private links or secrets.
